newsitem.title: UK: European jet edges up with futures, supply better.
newsitem.headline: European jet edges up with futures, supply better.

text.p: European jet fuel was a touch firmer with futures and narrowly stronger premiums the cause.
May IPE gas oil was 75 cents higher at $165.25 a tonne, in a catch-up play to crude's late gains on Thursday.
Traders said April's tightness was becoming less evident with more product now being shown.
Barge premiums were put at May IPE +$18.50 fob ARA with cargo premiums at May IPE +$24 cif NWE.
In the Mediterranean EU grade was pegged steady around fob high quotes +$8-9 with Libyan about $2-3 below this.
